subject: general
question: Which type of missile was the Python-5 test fired by DRDO in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Air-to-Air Missile.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO), successfully test-fired the 5th generation Python-5 missile from Tejas aircraft, at Goa.
 
• The **Python-5** missile is an Air-to-Air missile (AAM).
 
• The operational range of the Python-5 missiles is more than 20 KM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO):

 
 
• Founded: 1958
 
• Headquarters: DRDO Bhavan, New Delhi
 
• Motto: "Balasya Mulam Vigyanam"
 
• Comes under the Ministry of Defence
 
• Chairman: Samir V Kamat
 
• DRDO Day: 1 January.
